Game Overview

In Robo-Butcher, the core idea is straightforward: engage in relentless 2D platform-arena battles as a humanoid robot, striving for supremacy. Outmaneuver and obliterate waves of robotic adversaries with tactical agility. Upgrade your arsenal, seize power-ups from crates, and strategically exploit enemy weaknesses for a thrilling test of endurance and skill.
